sample_unit: patients (adults with moderate to severe major depression from antidepressant clinical trials)
models_evaluated: Deep learning model for differential treatment benefit prediction (AID-ME)

links.outcome: Whether model predictions amplified potentially harmful biases across patient subgroups
links.effect: Bias examination found the model did not amplify potentially harmful biases; overall test AUC 0.65, outperforming a null model (p = 0.01).
links.quote: The model did not amplify potentially harmful biases.

screen.reason: Evaluates a deep-learning predictive model for differential antidepressant treatment benefit on held-out retrospective clinical trial datasets with bias evaluation, prior to/reporting separately on trial deployment.
